messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Joint policyholder letters only include one name, leading to complaints.
  quote: they’re only pulling through one name, and it’s causing complaints
- problem: The system only includes one name—often the wrong one—when generating letters for policies that have two named holders.
  quote: Sure — when we generate letters for policies with two named holders, the system only pulls through one name, sometimes the wrong one.
- problem: Letters to joint policyholders only display a single name, leading to confusion and complaints.
  quote: Hi Bryn, we’ve got a repeat issue where letters sent to joint policyholders are only showing one name — it’s causing confusion and complaints from customers.
- problem: The system incorrectly merges joint policyholder names, showing only one or the wrong name.
  quote: We’re getting complaints because when there are joint ... policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes ... showing one or the wrong one
- problem: The system fails to merge both policyholder names, showing only one name on joint policies.
  quote: We’re getting complaints because the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names, and customers are understandably upset.
- problem: Joint policyholder names are not merged correctly, leading to customer complaints.
  quote: Appreciate you taking this seriously — we’ve had three complaints this month just because the joint policyholder names weren’t merged correctly.
- problem: Letters sent to joint policyholders only display a single name, leading to client complaints and friction.
  quote: Hi Bryn, we’re getting complaints again because letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing real friction with clients.
- problem: Letters to joint policyholders only show one name, causing complaints.
  quote: We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
